content: FastAPI + SQLite without an ORM: use stdlib sqlite3 with check_same_thread=False and WAL mode; run blocking DB calls off the event loop (FastAPI threadpool for sync def routes, or anyio.to_thread.run_sync). Lazy schema init happens in FastAPI lifespan/startup by executing CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS. encode/databases or SQLAlchemy Core are lightweight async alternatives if raw sqlite3 becomes limiting.
